prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 4:5 Instagram cover image
Primary request: Create a photorealistic Japanese-style kyotei motorboat racing scene on a wide lake course with soft mountains on the horizon, an overcast sky, and a gentle swell.
Scene/backdrop: Wide Japanese lake course; soft distant mountains; overcast atmosphere; realistic water.
Subject: Two or three kyotei racing boats in a close pack exiting a turn. Every boat must be a single-seat racing boat about 3 meters long, flat, low, and long relative to the racer, with a light-colored white or pale-grey hull. Each has an OPEN cockpit: no canopy, no roof, no windshield bubble. Each racer crouches or kneels low inside the open cockpit, leans forward, and holds a small steering wheel with both hands. Racers wear completely plain full-face helmets and plain racing suits; faces are not visible. Each boat has exactly one outboard motor at the stern and a large white spray plume behind it.
Style/medium: Highly realistic editorial sports photography, natural textures, convincing scale and hydrodynamics.
Composition/framing: Portrait 4:5. Boats occupy the lower half. Keep the top 45 percent dark, atmospheric, and visually uncluttered for a title overlay to be added later. Dynamic turn-exit angle while clearly showing open cockpits and stern-mounted outboard motors.
Lighting/mood: Moody soft overcast daylight, dramatic but natural.
Constraints: The boats must unmistakably look like Japanese kyotei racing boats, not offshore powerboats and not F1 tunnel boats. No recognizable real person.
Avoid: Absolutely no text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, brands, watermarks, signage, number plates, symbols, emblems, or flags anywhere. No writing-like marks on boats, helmets, suits, motors, water, or background. No canopy, roof, or windshield bubble.
refinement_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: final vertical 4:5 Instagram cover
Primary request: Keep the entire generated kyotei racing photograph unchanged except remove every small patch, badge, label, mark, writing-like detail, logo-like detail, symbol, letter, digit, and number from all racing suits, helmets, boats, and motors. In particular, remove the small grey rectangular patch on the red racer's chest and replace it seamlessly with plain red suit fabric.
Constraints: Preserve the same three boats, racers, open cockpits, composition, lake, spray, mountains, overcast lighting, portrait aspect ratio, and top negative space. All suits and helmets must be perfectly plain solid color. All hulls and motors must be plain and unmarked.
Avoid: Absolutely no text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, symbols, emblems, patches, labels, decals, or writing-like marks anywhere in the image.

verification.kyotei_boats: passed: three low, long single-seat racing boats with open cockpits and stern outboard motors
verification.composition: passed: portrait 4:5 with boats in the lower half and dark uncluttered upper area
verification.prohibited_content: passed: no visible text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, or flags
verification.people: passed: faces are obscured and no recognizable real person is depicted
